visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a vibrant close-up of a finished dish: a cold salad featuring bean curd skin, black wood ear mushrooms, and cilantro. Large red and white text overlays the top and middle of the frame. (2) Hands place dried, tubular bean curd skin into a metal bowl, followed by warm water pouring over them to soak. (3) A pair of hands holds two small, dried black wood ear mushrooms before showing a larger batch in a strainer. (4) A chef slices a carrot into thin rounds and then proceeds to cut a cucumber in half, then quarters, and uses a spoon to scrape out the seeds on a yellow cutting board. (5) The cucumber is sliced into sticks, placed in a small container with sugar and salt, and shaken vigorously. (6) Garlic is crushed and minced, followed by the fine chopping of green onions, cilantro stems, and red chili peppers. (7) Spices are measured into a blue and white patterned bowl; hot oil is then poured over the green onions and aromatics, causing white steam to rise. (8) Liquid seasonings like oyster sauce, soy sauce, and vinegar are poured into the bowl and mixed with a spoon. (9) A pink pot on an induction stove boils water; salt, carrots, and wood ear mushrooms are added to blanch. (10) The bean curd skin is added to the boiling water and stirred. (11) The blanched ingredients are strained and immediately plunged into a bowl of ice water, then strained again and squeezed by hand to remove excess moisture. (12) All ingredients, including the prepared cucumbers and fresh cilantro leaves, are combined in a large metal bowl, drizzled with the sauce, and tossed by hand wearing a plastic glove. (13) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a pink dress and a gray apron, eats a portion of the salad with chopsticks, smiles, and gives a thumbs up to the camera in a bright kitchen setting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 最近非常喜歡吃這道開胃小菜. [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 開胃、涮嘴涼拌菜. [Variety]: 涼拌腐竹黑木耳. (2) [Subtitle]: 乾腐竹先用溫水泡開. (3) [Subtitle]: 泡2個小時左右. (4) [Subtitle]: 泡到柔軟就可以了. (5) [Subtitle]: 準備小川耳. (6) [Subtitle]: 吃起來比較脆. (7) [Subtitle]: 紅蘿蔔切薄片. (8) [Subtitle]: 小黃瓜剖半再對半. (9) [Subtitle]: 用湯匙刮掉籽. (10) [Subtitle]: 比較不會出水. (11) [Subtitle]: 再將小黃瓜切成適當大小. (12) [Subtitle]: 接著加一匙糖、一點點鹽. (13) [Subtitle]: 搖一搖，靜置出水. (14) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭拍裂開來剁成蒜末. (15) [Subtitle]: 切點蔥花. (16) [Subtitle]: 香菜梗. (17) [Subtitle]: 辣椒切成圈. (18) [Subtitle]: 準備一個碗. (19) [Variety]: 需要文字食譜 請留言+1. (20) [Subtitle]: 放入韓式辣椒粉、胡椒粉、花椒粉. (21) [Subtitle]: 蒜末、辣椒、香菜、蔥花. (22) [Subtitle]: 用一個鍋子熱一下油. (23) [Subtitle]: 芝麻油+橄欖油 熱到160度. (24) [Subtitle]: 把熱油一口氣潑下去. (25) [Subtitle]: 立刻攪一攪. (26) [Subtitle]: 香氣整個炸出來了. (27) [Subtitle]: 加入糖、蠔油、醬油、醋，拌一拌. (28) [Subtitle]: 這碗靈魂醬汁就調好啦~. (29) [Subtitle]: 煮一鍋熱水 水裡加鹽. (30) [Subtitle]: 放入紅蘿蔔跟木耳. (31) [Subtitle]: 大約汆燙一分鐘. (32) [Subtitle]: 撈起來，瀝掉水分. (33) [Subtitle]: 接著再放入腐竹. (34) [Subtitle]: 煮4分鐘. (35) [Subtitle]: (如果腐竹沒泡透，可以多煮一下). (36) [Subtitle]: 撈起來 瀝乾水分. (37) [Subtitle]: 倒入冰水裡快速降溫. (38) [Subtitle]: 接著把水倒掉. (39) [Subtitle]: 擠掉多餘水分. (40) [Subtitle]: (避免影響調味). (41) [Subtitle]: 把所有的料丟到大盆子裡. (42) [Subtitle]: 還有小黃瓜 (去掉澀水). (43) [Subtitle]: 一些香菜葉. (44) [Subtitle]: 先加一半的醬汁. (45) [Subtitle]: (再按照個人口味增減). (46) [Subtitle]: 充分的拌勻. (47) [Subtitle]: 像這樣，超級開胃、香又涮嘴的. (48) [Variety]: 涼拌腐竹黑木耳，就完成啦~!. (49) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG. [Slogan]: 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房. [Slogan]: YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen. (50) [Subtitle]: 大家一定要試試看喔.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Cheerful, mid-tempo pop music begins with a soft synthesizer melody and a steady drum beat. A female voice speaks in a friendly, clear tone, introducing the dish. (2) A distinct sound of water splashing occurs as bean curd is soaked in a bowl. (3) Rhythmic, percussive chopping sounds are heard as a knife hits a wooden cutting board while slicing carrots and cucumbers. (4) The sound of a metal spoon scraping against a cucumber is clearly audible. (5) A rhythmic shaking sound occurs as a container with cucumbers and seasoning is agitated. (6) Fast, sharp chopping sounds for mincing garlic and other aromatics. (7) A high-pitched, sizzling sound of hot oil hitting fresh green onions and spices, accompanied by the clinking of a spoon against a ceramic bowl. (8) The sound of boiling water and various objects being placed into the pot follows. (9) Splashing and rushing water sounds as ingredients are blanched and cooled in ice water. (10) Squeezing and rustling sounds are heard as the salad is mixed by hand. (11) Enthusiastic final remarks from the narrator coincide with audible crunching and chewing sounds as the dish is tasted.
